content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: 'az9 capacity imbalance -> automated prefailover candidate' -> dispatched to @oncall-ryan :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: Acked. I'm inbound. Can someone post current scope/impact?

sre-ana: seeing ~30% increased 5xx from eu-west-az9 serving pool, connections are spiking and we have KV cache thrash on several shards. Autoscaler hasn't added capacity due to pending allocation errors. Logs: `shard-12: alloc_fail: insufficient_gpus`

eng-runtime: grabbing logs + RT. Looks like a NIC error causing packet loss to a subset of instances in az9. Control plane still sees nodes but egress RTT 200-400ms to some hosts.

pm-eli: Customer impact: a few mid-sized customers are getting timeouts at 99th pct. No complete region outage reported yet, but some requests are routed to fallback and customers may see higher latency or model version mismatch if we divert.

oncall-ryan: Plan: 1) Try automatic prefailover activation (non-disruptive) to route new sessions away from az9 2) If that fails, trigger sticky failover and scale up az8/az10 capacity 3) Notify CS + customers on rate-limited basis.

incident-bot: action: `prefailover: candidate_activate(az9 -> divert_to_az8,az10,policy=gradual)` queued; awaiting approval from oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: Approved. Run it.

infra-maya: Kicking off divert. Running `redwoodctl route adjust --from az9 --to az8,az10 --weight 0->60% --window 120s` now. Will post outputs.

eng-runtime: Observed initial 20% divert. Monitoring logs. If KV cache misses spike, we'll enable prefix cache warm-up on targets.

incident-bot: prefailover step1: route-change started at 2026-03-15T15:12:08Z; id=pf-6187654321-1

sre-ana: After 40s: az9 errors dropping by ~35% for diverted paths. However some long-lived sessions still anchored to az9 and see 504s. We should initiate sticky session handoff for canary customers.

customer-success-juno: I'm drafting a status note for affected customers: short blurb + ETA for mitigations. Will wait for final confirm before sending.

eng-runtime: Handoff command to migrate sticky sessions: ```redis-cli -h route-proxy -x migrate_stickies az9 az8  --batch 1000``` Running now (slowly).

oncall-ryan: Good. Also enable read-only fallback for background eval jobs to avoid overloading az8/az10. `jobsctl pause --queue=evals --region=global`

incident-bot: prefailover step1: route-change reached 60% diversion; step2 warming caches on az8/az10; id=pf-6187654321-2

sre-ana: Cache warm-up metrics look healthy. 5xx count in az9 down further. Latency in az8/az10 increased ~10ms but within SLO.

pm-eli: Recommend keeping diversion until at least 30m and then reassess. Also request eng-runtime to look into NIC degen on problematic instances and schedule eviction/reprovision.

eng-runtime: Captured kernel dmesg on two hosts showing NIC driver flaps. Opening reprovision job: `infra-reprovision --host host-az9-12 --image stable-2026-02-21 --reboot`

infra-maya: Started reprovision for host-az9-12 and host-az9-17. Rolling drain in progress.

customer-success-juno: Sending initial customer notification now: "We're aware of increased errors for a subset of deployments in eu-west-az9. Traffic is being proactively diverted to nearby zones and we expect mitigation within ~30 minutes. We'll follow up with a postmortem if this impacts you." Will CC impacted customers only. :email:

oncall-ryan: Update: PagerDuty escalation suppressed (we've acked and are actively mitigating). I'll stay on call for next 60m and then hand off to @sre-ana for night shift.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by oncall-ryan at 2026-03-15T15:15:12Z; escalation halted.

sre-ana: Host reprovisions finished; those hosts passed health checks and rejoined. Observed sticky session migration finished for ~85% of long-lived sessions. Remaining sessions are on connections > 10min and will drain naturally.

eng-runtime: We should keep the diversion until az9 error rate returns to baseline. Current error rate: az9 5xx = 0.8% (was 4.2% at peak), overall 99th latency elevated by 1.8s for affected customers only.

pm-eli: Noting business impact: no billing adjustments needed currently; we'll monitor. Please prepare a short postmortem draft focusing on autoscaler allocation failure + NIC flaps + mitigation timeline.

customer-success-juno: Customers notified. One customer (CapeAI) replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted. Any ETA on full restore?" I told them we'll update in 20m.

oncall-ryan: Switching to monitoring mode. If error rate <1% for 30m, I'll start gradual rollback of divert (60%->0 over 10min). If anything spikes, escalate to pd-urgent.

incident-bot: note: monitoring checks scheduled every 60s.

last-log: 2026-03-15T15:19:49Z - az9 5xx trending down; route-change stable.

sre-ana: Handing primary ownership to me for the night. Will post final status after 30m window.

oncall-ryan: Thanks team. Leaving channel. :wave:

sre-ana: Acknowledged. continuing to monitor.

customer-success-juno: I'll update customer thread after final confirmation.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active escalation handoff at 2026-03-15T15:24:49Z; owner=sre-ana; followup_task=postmortem-draft; ticket=INC-2026-0421
